title: You can drop me here
setting: In a rideshare, approaching Maya's hotel. The driveway looks tight. The driver is Nina. Slightly denser reductions; speed holds.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You can actually... sorry, can you drop me at the corner? The one with the drugstore.
lines.spoken: You can actually... sorry, can you drop me at the corner? The one with the drugstore.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah. Here's fine, actually. If you go all the way to the door, you'll get stuck in that driveway.
lines.spoken: Yeah. Here's fine, actually. If you go all the way to the door, you'll get stuck in that driveway.

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: Oh, I know that driveway. Yeah. I'll pull up on the right.
lines.spoken: Oh, I know that driveway. Yeah. I'll pull up on the right.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Perfect. You can just let me out here. This is great.
lines.spoken: Perfect. You can just lemme out here. This is great.

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: You got all your stuff? Bag in the back?
lines.spoken: You got all your stuff? Bag in the back?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I got it, I got it. Thanks. Do I just... it's already in the app, right?
lines.spoken: I got it, I got it. Thanks. Do I just... it's already in the app, right?

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: Yeah, you're all set. Have a good one.
lines.spoken: Yeah, you're all set. Have a good one.

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: Yep. Door's unlocked, just, you know, watch the bike lane.
lines.spoken: Yep. Door's unlocked, just, you know, watch the bike lane.

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: You sure you don't want me to go in a little more? I can if you want.
lines.spoken: You sure you don't want me to go in a little more? I can if you want.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: No, here's better. I don't want you stuck behind some delivery van.
lines.spoken: No, here's better. I don't want you stuck behind some delivery van.

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: Appreciate that. Okay, you're good to hop out.
lines.spoken: Appreciate that. Okay, you're good to hop out.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Thanks. See you. I mean, not see you, but—yeah. Thanks.
lines.spoken: Thanks. See you. I mean, not see you, but—yeah. Thanks.

gist.askZh: Maya 想在哪儿下车？为什么？
gist.askEn: Where does Maya want to get out, and why?
accept: the driveway would get the car stuck

gist.askZh: 司机同不同意？下车时要注意什么？
gist.askEn: Does the driver agree, and what should Maya watch for?

details.askZh: 付钱还用另外做什么吗？
details.askEn: Does Maya need to do anything else to pay?
accept: 已经在 App 里付了

details.askZh: 司机后来还问她要不要再往前开一点吗？
details.askEn: Does the driver offer to go in a little farther?

glue.span: can you drop me at the corner
glue.hear: can you drop me at the corner
glue.noteZh: drop me at the 四个词里 at the 极弱，像 drop me-uh-the corner。
glue.standard: can you drop me at the corner

glue.noteZh: Here's fine 是改口：刚才说了街角，现在表示‘这儿就行’；actually 常出现在这种临时改主意里。

glue.span: You can just let me out here
glue.hear: You can just lemme out here
glue.noteZh: let me 缩成 lemme，out here 连读；整句就是‘让我在这儿下就行’。
glue.standard: You can just let me out here

chunks.form: Can you drop me at the corner?
chunks.sayAfter: Sorry, can you drop me at the corner? The one with the drugstore.

chunks.form: You can just let me out here.
chunks.meaningZh: 你就在这儿让我下就行。
chunks.sayAfter: Perfect. You can just let me out here.

roleplay.setupZh: 车快到酒店了，但酒店车道很容易堵住。你要请司机在街角或药店旁让你下，确认行李，并问是不是已经在 App 里付过了。
roleplay.aiRole: Nina, a practical rideshare driver who knows this driveway. She'll confirm the corner, remind you about the bike lane, and offer to go farther in if you want.
variants: There's a car already stopped at the corner.
Maya almost leaves a bag in the back.
The app payment didn't go through.
mustUse: Can you drop me at the corner
starters: Can you drop me at the corner?
You can just let me out here.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲下车这一段：Maya 为什么不让车开进车道，她怎么跟司机说，下车时还确认了什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the drop-off: why Maya didn't want the driveway, how she asked, and what they confirmed as she got out. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
